data_description.confirm_targets: Voice Assist and Zalo commands list discovered phones, Zalo destinations, and speakers, then wait for a reply such as: choose 1 and 3.
data_description.speaker_enabled: Compatible media_player entities are scanned automatically whenever a reminder is created.
data_description.tts_entity_id: Optional. If left unset, Conversational Assistant automatically uses the first available TTS entity.
data_description.zalo_webhook_enabled: Does not create a new endpoint. Your existing webhook or automation calls conversational_assistant.process_zalo_webhook and passes its JSON body in the payload field.
data_description.zalo_webhook_bot_account_id: Required when Zalo webhook processing is enabled. Enter the bot account ID from your own Zalo webhook payload; it is used with isSelf and uidFrom to ignore messages sent by the bot itself.
data_description.zalo_webhook_account_selection: The account selector expected by zalo_bot.send_message, usually the bot phone number. If empty, the first configured Zalo destination account is used.
data_description.zalo_home_assistant_enabled: Routes state, room, area, floor, calendar, and Zalo-only device-control requests into Home Assistant. Device actions execute immediately except opening a rolling or garage door, which requires confirmation. Voice Assist keeps Home Assistant's native device control to avoid conflicts. Weather lookup uses the separate AI Search agent. Only entities exposed to Assist can be used.
data_description.zalo_conversation_agent_id: Choose the Home Assistant or custom Conversation agent that should interpret Zalo commands. Home Assistant Assist exposure settings are still enforced for calendars and built-in controls.
data_description.ai_search_agent_id: Choose an Internet-capable Conversation agent. It handles Vietnamese and English Internet search and weather lookup requests separately from the agent used to control Home Assistant.
data_description.ai_image_task_entity_id: Choose an AI Task entity that supports ai_task.generate_image. Image requests received from Zalo are sent to this agent and the completed image is returned to the same conversation.
data_description.ai_agent_failover_enabled: Enabled by default. The integration always tries the selected agent first. If it errors, returns no usable result, or times out, compatible agents available in Home Assistant are tried in sequence. Every agent receives a fresh timeout window, and Zalo reports the switch and total number of attempted agents.
data_description.ai_camera_task_entity_id: Choose an AI Task entity that supports ai_task.generate_data with camera attachments. It analyzes selected cameras for Voice Assist and Zalo.
data_description.ai_camera_instructions: Instructions sent to ai_task.generate_data for every selected camera. The default is the same camera-analysis prompt used in earlier versions; leaving it empty restores that default.
data_description.user_address: How the integration addresses the user in every reply. Default: Sếp Khải.
data_description.tts_language: Optional. Enter the exact language code supported by the selected TTS engine, for example vi. Leave blank to use the engine default.
data_description.tts_voice: Optional. Enter the exact voice name supported by the selected TTS engine. The value is sent as options.voice. Leave blank to use the engine default.
data_description.zalo_invocation_keyword_enabled: Enabled by default. When enabled, a new Zalo request must start with the configured keyword. Replies inside an active selection, confirmation, cancellation, or follow-up chat flow do not need the keyword. Messages outside an active flow without the keyword are silently ignored. Voice Assist is not affected.
data_description.zalo_invocation_keyword: Use the configured value only to start a new Zalo request, for example: [configured keyword] take a camera snapshot. While a selection, confirmation, cancellation, or follow-up chat flow is active, replies do not need the keyword. New requests require it again after the flow finishes or expires.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Conversational Assistant instance is supported.

init.description: Settings are organized by feature. Currently configured Zalo destinations: {zalo_count}.

general.title: General settings
general.description: Manage shared behavior and direct spoken names. Configured: {mobile_count} Mobile devices, {zalo_count} Zalo destinations, {speaker_count} speakers, {media_count} TV/media playback devices, and {camera_count} cameras.

calendar.title: Calendar settings
calendar.description: Choose default Solar/Lunar calendars, calendars to scan, and notification recipients. Found {calendar_count} calendars, {mobile_count} Mobile App devices, and {zalo_count} enabled Zalo destinations. Submit saves immediately.

data.calendar_lookahead_days: Number of upcoming days to scan
data.calendar_entities: Calendars to monitor and include in notifications
data.calendar_notification_enabled: Send a daily calendar notification when events exist
data.calendar_solar_entity_id: Default Solar calendar for new events
data.calendar_lunar_entity_id: Default Lunar calendar for new events

data_description.calendar_lookahead_days: Default: 30 days. The sensor only counts selected calendars and hides ordinary lunar dates without event content while keeping lunar day 1, day 15, and meaningful events.
data_description.calendar_entities: Only selected calendars are included in the sensor and daily summary. Selecting none disables calendar scanning.
data_description.calendar_notification_enabled: When enabled, the integration refreshes at the selected time and sends when events exist. A failure in one calendar no longer blocks valid events from other calendars.
data_description.calendar_notification_time: Local Home Assistant time. Default: 07:00 every day.
data_description.calendar_notification_mobile_devices: Select one or more Mobile App devices that always receive the calendar summary.
data_description.calendar_notification_zalo_targets: Select one or more enabled Zalo destinations already configured in Zalo settings.
data_description.calendar_solar_entity_id: Choose a writable calendar entity for explicitly solar events and converted lunar events when no lunar calendar is available.
data_description.calendar_lunar_entity_id: Choose a writable lunar calendar entity. Lunar dates are converted to their Gregorian service date before calendar.create_event is called.

weather.title: Weather settings
weather.description: Select a Home Assistant weather entity for native current conditions and forecasts. Direct and scheduled weather requests use Home Assistant first, then AI Search only when native data is unavailable or does not cover the requested place or period. Found {weather_count} weather entities and {zalo_count} enabled Zalo destinations. Submit saves immediately and re-registers every run time.

data.weather_location: Fallback location for AI Search and bulletins
data.weather_storm_enabled: Check storms that may affect Vietnam

data_description.weather_entity_id: Home Assistant automatically lists weather.* entities. The selected entity is used first with weather.get_forecasts for daily, hourly, or twice-daily data. Leave empty to skip native weather and use AI Search.
data_description.weather_location: Used by AI Search only when native Home Assistant data cannot answer the request, and as the scheduled bulletin location label. Leave blank to use the Home Assistant location name and coordinates.
data_description.weather_forecast_enabled: At each configured time, the integration first requests the selected Home Assistant weather entity. AI Search is used only when native data is unavailable or incomplete. Invalid/error text is never sent as a forecast bulletin.
data_description.weather_forecast_times: Enter HH:MM or HH:MM:SS values, one per line or comma-separated. Example: 06:30, 12:00, 21:00. Up to 24 distinct times.
data_description.weather_forecast_days: From 1 to 7 days. Each requested date is listed separately with condition, low/high temperature, rain, humidity, and wind when the source provides those fields.
data_description.weather_forecast_zalo_targets: Select one or more enabled destinations created under Zalo settings. Required when scheduled forecasts are enabled.
data_description.weather_storm_enabled: Storm checks still use current Internet sources because they cover regional systems and official warnings beyond one local weather entity. Zalo is sent only for an alert.
data_description.weather_storm_times: Enter HH:MM or HH:MM:SS values, one per line or comma-separated. Suggested defaults: 06:30, 12:00, and 21:00.
data_description.weather_storm_zalo_targets: Select one or more storm alert recipients. Required when scheduled storm checks are enabled.
